import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MODX = 1000000007L;
    static final long MODY = 998244353L;
    static final int maxk = 7;
    static final int base = 1000000;
    static long limit;
    static long counter;
    static int result;
    static int[] prefixSum = new int[maxk];
    static List<Integer>[] sequences = new ArrayList[maxk];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxk; i++) {
            sequences[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate(int x, int depth) {
        counter++;
        sequences[depth].add((int)(((counter - x) % MODY + MODY) % MODY));
        prefixSum[depth] = (int)((prefixSum[depth] + sequences[depth].get(sequences[depth].size() - 1)) % MODX);
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            generate(x * 10 + d, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void explore(long x) {
        if (x > limit) return;
        if (x * base + base - 1 <= limit && x * base * 10 > limit) {
            long currentOrder = counter;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int sz = sequences[i].size();
                int diff = (int)(((currentOrder - x * (long)Math.pow(10, i)) % MODY + MODY) % MODY);
                int pos = lowerBound(sequences[i], (int)(MODY - diff));
                result = (int)((result + 1L * diff * sz + prefixSum[i]) % MODX);
                result = (int)((result - 1L * MODX * (sz - pos) % MODX + MODX) % MODX);
                counter += sz;
            }
            return;
        }
        counter++;
        result = (int)((result + ((counter - x) % MODY + MODY) % MODY) % MODX);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            explore(x * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        limit = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        counter = 0;
        generate(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(sequences[i]);
        }
        counter = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            explore(i);
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
